biografia.citacao: Ronald Louis Fernández, a cultural anthropologist by training (Ph.D '78, McGill University, B.A. '70 UC Santa Barbara)
My interest in the guitarra stems from 1971 when I began to accompany Artur Gaipo in Montreal.

In 1974 my wife Jeanette and I attended a summer language and culture course at Coimbra University in Portugal. During that 5 week course we played music with Coimbra students and Lisbon working class musicians.
this event changed my life because it lead me to the world of fretted instrument repairing.
In 1994 I visited Lisboa and met Joao Palmeiro who made me a few Coimbra and Lisboa guitarras.
When necessary Ron Fernandez has restored these instruments to playing condition, refined the fret work and touched up the French Polished shellac finish.
